PluginData.Author: Local custom build
PluginData.Tooltip: Experimental headless Linux port using Pulsar and LinuxCompat
PluginData.Description: Custom Space Engineers 2 multiplayer dedicated server plugin for Linux headless using SE2 Online. Includes experimental docked-connector item transfer: exactly one paired connector must have Eject Items on to choose the transfer direction. Turn Eject Items off before disconnecting; items left in the active connector may be ejected into space or onto the ground. See the project README for details.
